run_autowrap_cli: run autowrap with header_paths and output_dir flags to generate MuJoCo ctypes Python bindings
parse_enums_from_headers: parse MuJoCo C header files to extract enum definitions using BindingGenerator parse_enums
parse_consts_typedefs: parse MuJoCo C header files to extract constants and typedef declarations using BindingGenerator parse_consts_typedefs
write_generated_consts: write parsed MuJoCo constants to a constants.py output file using BindingGenerator write_consts
write_generated_enums: write parsed MuJoCo enums to an enums.py output file using BindingGenerator write_enums
